description: K₂NaAg₃(CN)₆ is Potassium Silver Cyanide-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P̅31m space group. K is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form distorted KN₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent KN₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaN₆ octahedra. All K-N bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form NaN₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent KN₆ octahedra. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.58 Å. Ag is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent C atoms. Both Ag-C bond lengths are 2.05 Å. C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. N is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one C atom.
